ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: In case collections and recorded sayings, an interjected comment (著語) is compact wording inserted against a cited exchange, often immediately after one of its lines and introduced by “appends a comment and says” (著語云).
EvidenceBody: The Blue Cliff Record preserves Xuedou Chongxian's repeated comments such as “seen through,” and Yuanwu Keqin's recorded sayings insert “wrong” after successive turns of an older case. Wansong Xingxiu explicitly quotes comments by Yuanwu and then answers them from his own position.

Tianyin Yuanxiu and Hongzhi Zhengjue likewise interrupt cited exchanges with short verdicts. A reviewed unnamed monastic questioner asks Langting Ting for a comment on a named case, while Xiangtian Jinian says he will place a comment against each line. The form can therefore name either the inserted wording or the act of adding it; it does not denote ordinary authorship where the verb authored merely precedes the noun recorded sayings.

Senses.Note: Seven exact witnesses in seven independent works support the case-comment sense; false segmentation in the phrase recorded sayings that one authored is excluded.

DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: The Blue Cliff Record commentary uses Yuanwu's report frame to identify the following historical comment as Xuedou's.
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Yuanwu owns the headword-bearing report frame; Xuedou owns only the reported historical comment words.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: A short voice is inserted directly into an inherited exchange so that transmission and present judgment occupy the same case page.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The contiguous characters also occur across the boundary in “authored a recorded-sayings collection” (著語錄); those strings are not evidence for the technical case-comment sense.

ComparedThings: act of placing comments line by line
DifferentThingTest.Reason: The nominal and verbal deployments share the act and product of inserting compact words against cited material.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Aliases cover the comment's insertion, its case setting, and its page-level annotation function.

ModifierControls.Finding: 著 can mark placing or adding and 語 the inserted words; English target uses the resulting comment while explanation covers the act.

FamilyControls.Finding: The nearby phrase “supply words” (下語) can denote providing a comment; it is related but not substituted into exact evidence.
The phrase “the recorded sayings that one authored” (所著語錄) splits as “authored” (著) plus “recorded sayings” (語錄), so it is explicitly excluded.
